errors.evidence: The chart displays only one data series, not two. The description incorrectly states there are two lines.
The value at Epoch 10 is significantly higher, close to 0.0010 (approximately 0.00098). The value 0.0008 corresponds to approximately Epoch 16 on the chart.

errors.text_span: 另一条是蓝色的实线，标记为加号（+），从Epoch 1处的值约为0.0002开始，持续下降，在Epoch 25处的值约为0.00005，至Epoch 30结束时值为0。
errors.evidence: This entire sentence describes a second line that does not exist in the figure. There is no blue solid line with plus (+) markers.
The major tick marks on the x-axis are labeled at 1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30. The interval between these labels is not 1.

The single data line in the chart has two types of markers: blue circles for the first few epochs (1-5) and blue stars for the later epochs (6-30). Describing it as only having star markers is incomplete.
The peak value at Epoch 5 is exactly at the 0.0010 line, not 0.0009.
